programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "The Showdown"
programme.desc: Torie stakes her reputation on an Apollo 17 map used on the surface of the moon; Larry gets his hands on a one-of-a-kind Skylab prototype; and Cole acquires a mysterious homing beacon. To make big money and win the ticket Cole has to turn detective.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Rockets & Propulsion"

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Satellites"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli delves into the world of satellites.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "The All-Powerful Sun"

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S1 - "Extreme Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli meets with a team of scientists to discuss the death of massive stars in the Universe.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Arming Space Force"

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Suing Our Way To Space"

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Proving Einstein"
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein’s theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: Space Dealers S1 - "Dealers on a Mission"
programme.desc: Larry takes on an impossible mission: he’s been asked to find an item worn in space by Apollo 15 legend Al Worden. Torie searches for Russian space items for a museum in San Francisco and Cole goes on the hunt for an item from Apollo 13.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Space Junk Dangers"
programme.desc: A ballistic missile test by India recently shot down one of its own communications satellites. With over 900,000 pieces of debris currently orbiting planet Earth, space trash has become a very real threat to ongoing missions.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hurricanes '07"
programme.desc: We hope Season Two will give us the opportunity to make the quintessential Angry Planet show – a full episode exploring a major hurricane that makes landfall in Florida or the Carolinas.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "B.C. Caving"
programme.desc: In the porous limestone of Canada’s West Coast, great forces are at work under the ground, building and eroding the underground into fantastic shapes. In this episode we’ll witness George’s explorations of these massive underground cave systems.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hot and Cold Crystals"
programme.desc: Miners in Chihauhau, Mexico, has just discovered an amazing sight. The Mexican authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews – “Angry Planet” plans to be one of the first in!

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Thunder Down Under"
programme.desc: In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Steam-Powered Boat, Waterwall"
